accessibility_responsive_review.validation_method: Headless browser validation on the approved French core, with SAFE-8F rerun required against activation-derived blobs.
accessibility_responsive_review.note: Focused release-gate review only; not a claim of full WCAG conformance certification.

design.home_rule: Publish a reciprocal mk/en/fr/x-default Home cluster in sitemap.xml in SAFE-8F.
design.institute_rule: Do not publish a misleading Institute hreflang cluster while MK and EN share /institute.html.

route_fallback_smoke_test.validation_method: GitHub Actions branch-local HTTP smoke test; SAFE-8F rerun required against activation branch.

workflow_harness_note.detail: The French technical workflow YAML/parser harness was repaired and subsequently completed successfully before SAFE-8F activation work began.

activation_rule: Technical and Human Gate evidence permit only the dedicated SAFE-8F French activation candidate. Final public effect requires successful activation CI and exact-head merge.
